title: SEC charges concerning Abra Earn
notes: SEC litigation release stating that Abra began winding down Abra Earn in June 2023 and instructed United States customers to withdraw. It does not provide an exact product-wide completion date.

title: Multistate settlement concerning Abra customer assets
notes: Multistate regulatory source stating that Abra ceased accepting virtual-asset allocations from United States Abra Trade customers as of 15 June 2023. This population is not silently equated with every Abra Earn customer.

title: SEC description of Abra Earn scale and operation
notes: The SEC states that Abra Earn launched in the United States around July 2020 and reached approximately $600 million in assets, including approximately $500 million from United States investors. Month-level timing is preserved without assigning an invented launch day.

title: SEC allegations concerning Abra Earn asset use
notes: The SEC release summarizes allegations that Plutus Lending exercised discretion over investor assets to earn income and fund interest payments. Abra consented to judgment without admitting or denying the allegations, so this is not converted into a definitive customer-ownership or segregation conclusion.

title: State regulators settle with Abra for return of cryptocurrency assets
notes: Primary source for the multistate settlement and the statement that up to $82.1 million in remaining virtual assets would be returned to consumers in participating states. It is not proof of universal completed recovery or an Abra Earn-specific recovery rate.

title: SEC files settled Abra Earn charges
notes: Primary source for the settled SEC charges against Plutus Lending LLC concerning Abra Earn and operation as an unregistered investment company.

title: Final judgment entered against Plutus Lending LLC
notes: SEC release reporting that final judgment was entered on 13 January 2025, including a permanent injunction and $1.65 million civil penalty. The judgment resolves the SEC case, not every customer withdrawal or state-settlement obligation.
